Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the parking lot collision
you reported in Sugar Land, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just give you the facts of what happened, if that's alright.
Q: That's fine, but I do need you to identify yourself for the file. Can you confirm your name?
A: Sure. It's the person listed as the driver on the policy paperwork.
Q: Understood. Can you describe where you were when the collision occurred?
A: I was backing out of a parking space in a large retail lot. It was late afternoon and the lot was pretty busy.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before contact?
A: Not right away. I checked my mirrors and saw nothing, but then I heard a horn and felt the impact on the rear
passenger side of my car.
Q: How fast were you moving when you started backing?
A: Very slowly, maybe walking pace. I was still turinng the wheel when it happened.
Q: Were you injured in the collision?
A: Yes. My right knee hit the dashboard area when the car jolted. It swelled up within a few hours and I've had trouble
bearing weight on it since.
Q: Have you received medical treatment for the knee?
A: I went to an urgent care clinic that same evening. They took X-rays and told me to follow up with an orthopedic
doctor. I have an appointment set up for later this week.
Q: Were there any witnesses you're aware of?
A: I'm not sure. A couple of people were walking nearby, but I didn't get their names.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your account?
A: Only that I've been careful about this from the start and I want the damage to my car and my knee dealt with
properly.
Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
